IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: The mission of RUI's Prevention Program, Rise Up Leadership Academy (RULA), is to protect at-risk youth from being recruited into gangs-an issue that can begin as early as age 12. Launched at the start of the school year with its first cohort of 5th graders, the program offers a safe and supportive environment where students can engage in sports, entertainment, tutoring, and social skill development. Through these activities, RULA empowers youth to recognize their self-worth and strive toward their full potential.
IRS990.MissionDesc: RUI's mission is to minimize gang involvement by providing integrated gang prevention, intervention, and post detention reentry services. Of these three prongs, RUI currently provides reentry and gang prevention services. Reentry program services are devoted to 18 months of job training, counseling, case management, mentoring, tattoo removal, and spiritual enrichment services that enable persons with previous gang involvement who have been released from incarceration to successfully become a contributing member of society. RULA launched in August 2024, in partnership with Rosa Parks Elementary and the City Heights Recreation Center.
IRS990.Desc: Machine Shop Social Enterprise MSSE - MSSE provides on-the-job training for program members preparing them for careers as CNC machine operators. Members receive real world work experience on contract work in a Department of Labor approved apprenticeship program.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: Member Services - Reentry Program members received a comprehensive set of wraparound services during the 18-month program. Services included case management services, counseling, mentoring, recovery and relapse prevention programs, tattoo removal, financial literacy training, classroom training related to CNC fundamentals, and assistance with resume writing, mock interviews and job searching for employment after graduation.
